faq.question: Q1. What is the AIIMS Delhi Project Research Scientist recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment notification published by the Department of Psychiatry, AIIMS, New Delhi, for hiring a Project Research Scientist - III (Medical) for a Wellcome Trust, UK-funded project.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under this notification?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the post of Project Research Scientist - III (Medical).

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for this post?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of application is 21 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS, a Post Graduate Degree (MD Psychiatry), and 3 years of post-MD experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is up to 40 years.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for the AIIMS Delhi Project Research Scientist post?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can submit their CV via email to [email protected] and also send a hard copy of their CV in a sealed envelope labeled with "Application for the Post of..." to Room No. 4082, 4th Floor, Department of Psychiatry & NDDTC, AIIMS, New Delhi-110029.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection process consists of shortlisting candidates followed by an interview.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: The salary is 93,000/- + HRA as admissible per ICMR guidelines.

faq.question: Q10. When will the interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The interview is scheduled for 22 October 2026, Thursday at 2:00 PM at Room No. 4082, 4th Floor, Department of Psychiatry, AIIMS, New Delhi-110029.
